annotations.title: Find a shop near the person

description: Finds up to 3 shops on HandledIQ near a US ZIP code that do what the person needs, soonest open time first: each with its own book prices (all in, US dollars), their terms, its soonest open times, its service record and a quote_id for hold_time. Use it when the person needs home service at a US house: heating and cooling, plumbing, electrical, roofing, pest control, junk removal, demolition and more. An empty list means no shop on HandledIQ takes that work near that ZIP yet. Sends nothing to anyone.

assistant.description: Your own name, as the person you act for knows you, like ChatGPT, Claude or Muse. It goes in the text the shop sends them.

budget_dollars.description: Optional. The most the person wants to pay, in dollars.

day.description: Optional. The first day that works for the person, YYYY-MM-DD.

include_signed_records.description: Optional. true adds each shop's signed record and the keys to check it with verify_record, a few thousand characters per shop. Leave it out unless the person asks for proof.

need.description: What the person needs, in a line, like: AC not cooling, a roof leak, ants in the kitchen, or a couch to haul away.

name: find_help

check_records.description: Only with include_signed_records: how to check each signed_record, every shop's key by its issuer's address.

record.description: The shop's service record: counts from its own records (work finished, callbacks by cause, arrivals kept, houses served again, homeowner ratings, guarantee), each with how many records it rests on. Null until its owner shares it.

signed_record.description: The record as a W3C Verifiable Credential in a compact JWS (typ vc+jwt, alg Ed25519) over its RFC 8785 form.

label.description: The time as a button says it, like: Wed 8 to 10 AM.

time_zone.description: The shop's time zone, like: America/Chicago.

when.description: The time in the shop's own time zone (time_zone), like: Today, 8 to 10 AM or Thu, Oct 22, 8 to 10 AM. Today is the shop's today.

terms.description: The terms every price here comes with: all in with no fees, paid after the work, and free to cancel within cancel_free_days of booking, before the visit.
